v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Iacob autem * génuit Ioseph, virum Maríæ, de qua natus est Iesus, qui vocátur Christus.
text.en: And Jacob begat Joseph * the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, Who is called Christ.

text.la: Missus est * Angelus Gábriel a Deo ad Vírginem desponsátam viro, cui nomen erat Ioseph, de domo David, et nomen Vírginis María.
text.en: The Angel Gabriel * was sent from God, unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth, to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David, and the virgin's name was Mary.

text.la: Cum esset desponsáta * Mater Iesu María Ioseph, ántequam convenírent, invénta est in útero habens de Spíritu Sancto.
text.en: When as Mary * the mother of Jesus, was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child, of the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Ioseph vir eius, * cum esset iustus, et nollet eam tradúcere, vóluit occúlte dimíttere eam.
text.en: Then Joseph her husband * being a just man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.

text.la: Angelus Dómini * appáruit Ioseph, dicens: Ioseph, fili David, noli timére accípere Maríam cóniugem tuam; quod enim in ea natum est, de Spíritu Sancto est: páriet autem fílium, et vocábis nomen eius Iesum.
text.en: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord * appeared unto him in a dream, saying: Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee, Mary, thy wife; for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost: and she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call His name Jesus.

text.la: Exsúrgens Ioseph a somno, * fecit sicut præcépit ei Angelus Dómini, et accépit cóniugem suam.
text.en: Joseph, being raised * from sleep, did as the Angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife.

text.la: Sanctíssimæ Genetrícis tuæ sponsi, quǽsumus, Dómine, méritis adiuvémur; ut quod possibílitas nostra non óbtinet, eius nobis intercessióne donétur.
text.en: Help us, we beseech thee, O Lord, for the sake of the Husband of thy most holy Mother, that what we cannot for ourselves obtain, Thou mayest grant us at his petition.

text.la: Desidério desiderávi hoc Pascha manducáre vobíscum, ántequam pátiar.
text.en: With desire I have desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.

v.la: Éripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo.
v.en: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man.

r.en: Rescue me from the unjust man.

text.la: Esto, quǽsumus, Dómine, propítius plebi tuæ: ut, quæ tibi non placent, respuéntes, tuórum pótius repleántur delectatiónibus mandatórum.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee deal mercifully with thy people, and fill plentifully with the rich things of thy commandments all them who at this time do, to fulfill thy will, turn away from that which displeaseth thee.
